From 9779a8e61a83916ccfe7e6ddabcc7638d4bc2ae1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>

Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: Intel: boards: fix randconfig issue

on x86_64:

ERROR: modpost: "sof_dai_get_bclk"
[sound/soc/intel/boards/snd-soc-intel-sof-cirrus-common.ko] undefined!

ERROR: modpost: "sof_dai_get_mclk"
[sound/soc/intel/boards/snd-soc-intel-sof-realtek-common.ko]
undefined!

This comes from a missing dependency on at least ONE SOF platform
being selected. This dependency exists for all other machine drivers,
this was missed in the earlier reviews.

Fixes: 2fe14ff61bd6 ("ASoC: Intel: sof_ssp_amp: rename driver and support cs35l41 amplifier")
Reported-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Signed-off-by: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
Acked-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Tested-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Reviewed-by: Cezary Rojewski <cezary.rojewski@intel.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220308202318.401358-1-pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig b/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
index 6884ddf9edad..81e012c164b0 100644
--- a/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
+++ b/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
@@ -615,6 +615,8 @@ config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_DA7219_MAX98373_MACH
 
 endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_JASPERLAKE
 
+if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
+
 config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
 	tristate "SOF with amplifiers in I2S Mode"
 	depends on I2C && ACPI
@@ -631,6 +633,7 @@ config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
 	   with RT1308/CS35L41 I2S audio codec.
 	   Say Y if you have such a device.
 	   If unsure select "N".
+endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
 
 if SND_SOC_SOF_ELKHARTLAKE
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig`**
   - Added a conditional block that checks for `SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK`.
   - Wrapped the configuration for `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` within this conditional block.
   - This change ensures that the `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` configuration is only available if the `SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK` option is enabled.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `Kconfig` file addresses a dependency issue that was causing undefined references to `sof_dai_get_bclk` and `sof_dai_get_mclk` when certain configurations were not selected. By adding the conditional dependency on `SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK`, the patch ensures that the `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` configuration is only available when the necessary SOF platform is selected, thus preventing the undefined symbol errors reported. This change aligns the configuration with the existing dependencies of other machine drivers, which were previously overlooked.

Fixes: 2fe14ff61bd6 ("ASoC: Intel: sof_ssp_amp: rename driver and support cs35l41 amplifier")

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a missing dependency in the Kconfig file that resulted in the `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` configuration being available without the necessary SOF platform being selected. This led to undefined references to the functions `sof_dai_get_bclk` and `sof_dai_get_mclk` when building the kernel with certain configurations, particularly in randconfig scenarios.

Here is the patch:
 endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_JASPERLAKE
 
+if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
+
 config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
 	tristate "SOF with amplifiers in I2S Mode"
 	   Say Y if you have such a device.
 	   If unsure select "N".
+endif ## SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
 
 if SND_SOC_SOF_ELKHARTLAKE

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
tristate "SOF with amplifiers in I2S Mode"
```
Reason:
The `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` configuration was available without the necessary SOF platform being selected, which caused the kernel to reference undefined functions `sof_dai_get_bclk` and `sof_dai_get_mclk` during the build process.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK
config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH
```
Reason:
By adding the conditional `if SND_SOC_SOF_HDA_LINK`, the configuration for `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOF_SSP_AMP_MACH` is now dependent on the selection of a valid SOF platform, ensuring that the necessary functions are defined and preventing the undefined reference errors during the kernel build.
